decisions.choice: Copy lives in a plain typed content/landing.ts keyed by locale (en complete, ta/kn partial with fallback) and does not add @causedeck/i18n as a dependency of the site.
decisions.justification: The issue names apps/site/content/landing.ts as the i18n-ready copy constant. The site has no next-intl setup and packages/i18n is the app catalog (packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts). Adding a workspace dependency would need its own architecture justification.

decisions.choice: Trust claims link to planned /security/#anchor targets even though the security page (#91) is not merged yet; the e2e spec asserts the href shape and does not follow them.
decisions.justification: The issue requires the links, and #91 is open and out of scope here. Following the links would 404 until #91 lands; the anchors must be reconciled when #91 merges.

decisions.choice: Reveal and parallax motion is CSS-only (scroll-driven or intersection-free) and guarded by prefers-reduced-motion; no animation library is added.
decisions.justification: The 120 KB gzip JS budget (R10) and the static CSP in apps/site/scripts/write-headers.ts:32-66 argue against extra client JS; e2e/playwright.site.config.ts:22 already runs with reduced motion.

decisions.choice: Reuse app/opengraph-image.tsx (build-time OG for the root route) for the landing OG image instead of committing public/og/landing.png.
decisions.justification: apps/site/app/opengraph-image.tsx already generates the OG image at build for '/'. A committed binary would drift from the page; the issue's own wording is 'generated from the page at build'.
